scenarios.question_zh: 不同芯片、模型、工具链和智能体接口能否在公开测试协议下协作？
scenarios.question_en: Can different chips, models, toolchains, and agent interfaces work together under an open test protocol?
scenarios.operation_zh: 预约测试、协议公开、第三方复测、失败记录入库
scenarios.operation_en: Scheduled trials, open protocols, independent retesting, and archived failures
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 仅使用获授权测试数据和合成数据；不接入生产系统
scenarios.data_boundary_en: Use only cleared test or synthetic data; no connection to production systems
scenarios.human_review: 测试负责人签署结果，外部复测后方可发布
scenarios.rollback: 接口隔离、版本回退、立即终止试验
scenarios.privacy_boundary: 不需要个人身份或行为数据
scenarios.accessibility_review: 观察廊、报告和控制台均提供无障碍版本

scenarios.name_zh: 具身智能低速共存测试街
scenarios.question_zh: 机器人能否在受控、可暂停、有人工监督的环境中与行人安全共享空间？
scenarios.question_en: Can robots safely share space with people in a controlled, pausable, human-supervised environment?
scenarios.operation_zh: 分时预约、地理围栏、现场安全员、公开事件复盘
scenarios.operation_en: Time slots, geofencing, on-site safety stewards, and public incident review
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 默认边缘处理并模糊化旁观者；不保存无关影像
scenarios.data_boundary_en: Default edge processing and bystander obfuscation; no retention of irrelevant footage
scenarios.human_review: 现场安全员拥有最高控制权
scenarios.rollback: 物理急停、远程停机、人工撤离路线
scenarios.privacy_boundary: 不以人脸识别定位行人
scenarios.accessibility_review: 轮椅、导盲、儿童和听障情境共同测试

scenarios.name_zh: 城市智能体韧性演练舱
scenarios.question_zh: 城市智能体失效、受攻击或产生错误建议时，能否被发现、隔离、人工接管并恢复？
scenarios.question_en: When an urban agent fails, is attacked, or gives harmful advice, can it be detected, isolated, taken over, and recovered?
scenarios.operation_zh: 情景注入、红队测试、人工接管演练、恢复复盘
scenarios.operation_en: Scenario injection, red teaming, human takeover drills, and recovery review
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 只使用脱敏或合成城市数据，禁止连接真实控制设备
scenarios.data_boundary_en: Only de-identified or synthetic urban data; no link to real control equipment
scenarios.human_review: 城市专业人员对所有建议作最终判断
scenarios.rollback: 沙盒隔离、状态快照、人工恢复
scenarios.accessibility_review: 告警同时提供视觉、听觉和触觉通道

scenarios.question_zh: 视障者、老年人和行动不便者能否真正理解、纠错并退出 AI 导航？
scenarios.question_en: Can blind, older, and mobility-impaired users understand, correct, and leave AI wayfinding?
scenarios.operation_zh: 共同踏勘、路径试用、障碍报告、人工更新
scenarios.operation_en: Co-walk audits, route trials, barrier reports, and human updates
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 位置数据在设备端处理，参与者可匿名反馈
scenarios.data_boundary_en: Location data processed on device; anonymous feedback available
scenarios.human_review: 无障碍共同设计者确认改动优先级
scenarios.rollback: 纸质地图、人工引导、关闭错误路线
scenarios.accessibility_review: 由残障共同设计者主导持续审查

scenarios.question_zh: 公共服务 AI 能否解释信息来源，并在一步内转交人工服务？
scenarios.question_en: Can a public-service AI explain its sources and hand a person to human service in one step?
scenarios.operation_zh: 信息检索、来源展示、人工接续、错误纠正
scenarios.operation_en: Information retrieval, source display, human handoff, and error correction
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 默认不保存对话；敏感事项仅由人工处理
scenarios.data_boundary_en: Conversations are not retained by default; sensitive matters remain human-only
scenarios.human_review: 人工服务人员拥有最终解释权
scenarios.rollback: 一键转人工、纸质与电话替代
scenarios.privacy_boundary: 不把身份信息用于模型训练
scenarios.accessibility_review: 提供大字、语音、手语转介和多语言

scenarios.question_zh: 青少年能否在不交出不必要个人数据的前提下学习模型、代码和数据素养？
scenarios.question_en: Can young people learn models, code, and data literacy without surrendering unnecessary personal data?
scenarios.operation_zh: 导师工作坊、离线实验、开源贡献、监护知情
scenarios.operation_en: Mentored workshops, offline experiments, open-source contribution, and informed guardians
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 不收集广告画像，不把学生作品默认用于训练
scenarios.data_boundary_en: No advertising profiles; student work is not training data by default
scenarios.human_review: 导师审核内容、风险和贡献发布
scenarios.rollback: 离线模式、删除作品、撤回公开贡献
scenarios.privacy_boundary: 最小年龄信息且不要求生物识别
scenarios.accessibility_review: 多感官教材和低带宽离线版本

scenarios.question_zh: AI 能否通过匿名或聚合数据帮助优化遮阴、休憩和微气候体验，而不形成个体监控？
scenarios.question_en: Can AI improve shade, rest, and microclimate comfort with anonymous or aggregate data rather than individual surveillance?
scenarios.operation_zh: 匿名舒适投票、传感器校准、季节性设施调整
scenarios.operation_en: Anonymous comfort voting, sensor calibration, and seasonal facility adjustment
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 仅记录环境值与聚合反馈
scenarios.data_boundary_en: Record only environmental values and aggregated feedback
scenarios.human_review: 园林、运营和公众共同审阅调整
scenarios.rollback: 恢复固定照明与人工维护模式
scenarios.privacy_boundary: 无摄像识别和个体轨迹
scenarios.accessibility_review: 轮椅转弯、坐凳高度和感官负担共同测试

scenarios.question_zh: 智能照明、活动和安全系统能否同时满足夜间安全、节能、安静和隐私？
scenarios.question_en: Can smart lighting, activity, and safety systems support safety, energy restraint, quiet, and privacy at once?
scenarios.operation_zh: 时段规则、照度试验、噪声协商、投诉复盘
scenarios.operation_en: Time-based rules, lighting trials, noise negotiation, and complaint review
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 仅使用环境声级和照度，不录制可识别谈话
scenarios.data_boundary_en: Use sound levels and illuminance only; do not record identifiable conversations
scenarios.human_review: 夜间运营规则由居民和运营者共同确认
scenarios.rollback: 切换固定保守照明并暂停活动
scenarios.privacy_boundary: 不使用人脸追踪评估安全
scenarios.accessibility_review: 眩光、频闪、听觉和认知负担审查

scenarios.question_zh: AI 能否基于有出处的档案讲述铁路历史，并明确区分事实、推断和创作？
scenarios.question_en: Can AI interpret railway history from sourced archives while separating fact, inference, and creation?
scenarios.operation_zh: 档案清点、事实标注、专家复核、公众纠错
scenarios.operation_en: Archive inventory, fact labels, expert review, and public correction
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 只使用可公开和可清权资料
scenarios.data_boundary_en: Use only public and rights-cleared material
scenarios.human_review: 历史专业人员审核核心叙述
scenarios.rollback: 下线错误内容并保留更正记录
scenarios.privacy_boundary: 口述史须取得明确授权
scenarios.accessibility_review: 文本、音频、触觉和简明语言版本

scenarios.question_zh: 普通开发者、居民、维护者和研究者的真实贡献能否在取得同意后被城市长期记录？
scenarios.question_en: Can the real contributions of developers, residents, maintainers, and researchers be recorded by the city with consent?
scenarios.operation_zh: 贡献提名、证据核验、授权展示、版本更新
scenarios.operation_en: Contribution nomination, evidence verification, display consent, and version updates
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 只展示明确授权的姓名或匿名标识
scenarios.data_boundary_en: Display only expressly authorized names or anonymous identifiers
scenarios.human_review: 维护委员会核验贡献与撤回请求
scenarios.rollback: 随时匿名化或撤下记录
scenarios.privacy_boundary: 不以公开身份作为参与条件
scenarios.accessibility_review: 地面、墙面、语音和线上文本等价

scenarios.question_zh: AI 产品能否在购买和规模部署前接受公众试用、无障碍检查、风险说明和人工服务验证？
scenarios.question_en: Can AI products undergo public trials, accessibility checks, risk disclosure, and human-service validation before purchase or scale-up?
scenarios.operation_zh: 限时试用、风险卡、无障碍审查、问题回收
scenarios.operation_en: Time-bounded trials, risk cards, accessibility review, and issue collection
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 试用数据默认本地保存且可删除
scenarios.data_boundary_en: Trial data stays local by default and remains deletable
scenarios.human_review: 产品方和独立用户审查共同签署证据
scenarios.rollback: 撤柜、退款/退出路径、停用远程服务
scenarios.privacy_boundary: 不以画像营销作为试用条件
scenarios.accessibility_review: 无障碍共同设计者拥有公开评价栏

scenarios.question_zh: 不同城市能否使用可比较的证据模板讨论共同问题，而不是只交换宣传口号？
scenarios.question_en: Can cities discuss shared problems through comparable evidence templates rather than promotional slogans?
scenarios.operation_zh: 问题征集、证据对照、公众评议、年度发布
scenarios.operation_en: Question call, evidence comparison, public review, and annual release
scenarios.data_boundary_zh: 只发布获得授权、可复核和去识别化的结果
scenarios.data_boundary_en: Publish only authorized, reviewable, de-identified results
scenarios.human_review: 多利益相关方编辑委员会审定发布边界
scenarios.rollback: 撤回错误条目并保留公开更正
scenarios.privacy_boundary: 案例不得包含可识别个人数据
scenarios.accessibility_review: 会议、展览和数字材料提供等价无障碍通道
